description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the ProjectLocation model in the Goteo project, including tests for creation, validation, persistence, and location-based functionalities.

classes.name: ProjectLocationTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test cases for the ProjectLocation model, testing its creation, validation, database interactions, and location-related functionalities.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the ProjectLocation class and verifies its type.

methods.name: testDefaultValidation
methods.description: Checks that a new ProjectLocation instance fails validation and save without required data.

methods.name: testAddProjectLocation
methods.description: Creates a ProjectLocation with predefined data and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testSaveProjectLocationNonProject
methods.description: Attempts to save a project location when no project is linked, expecting failure.

methods.name: testCreateProject
methods.description: Associates a ProjectLocation with an existing test project and user.

methods.name: testSaveProjectLocation
methods.description: Validates and saves a ProjectLocation, then retrieves and verifies persisted data.

methods.name: testSetLocable
methods.description: Tests setting a location as locable and unlocable, verifying status and properties.

methods.name: testSetProperty
methods.description: Sets an arbitrary property ('info') on a ProjectLocation and verifies it.

methods.name: testNearbyEmpty
methods.description: Checks nearby locations for a project without location data, expecting empty.

methods.name: testNearbyEmptyProjects
methods.description: Checks for nearby projects given a user location, expecting no results.

methods.name: testNearby
methods.description: Creates a nearby user location and verifies that the project location appears in nearby results.

methods.name: testRemoveAddLocationEntry
methods.description: Deletes a ProjectLocation entry and verifies it is no longer retrievable.
